item.title: BISU BALIK sa Bohol TBI Recognized at the ReSEED Honors 2025
item.description: Bohol Island State University’s very own BISU BALIK sa Bohol TBI received national recognition at the ReSEED Honors 2025, presented by SCALE NCR during the 9th Technology Business Incubation (TBI) Summit. The Rising TBI Award was conferred upon BISU BALIK sa Bohol TBI for its exceptional growth and strong potential to become a leading innovation hub in the country.

item.title: 2025 University Paugnat ug Pasundayag
item.description: In a celebration ablaze with color, pride, and unity, all six campuses of Bohol Island State University (BISU) converged this week for the highly anticipated Paugnat ug Pasundayag 2025. The host, BISU Balilihan Campus, warmly welcomed the delegates from November 12–14 for the university’s premier athletic and cultural gathering.

item.title: BISU Recognized as a CHED Internationalization Champions of Nation-Building and Sustainability (ICONS) Awardee
item.description: Bohol Island State University (BISU) proudly marks its first-ever recognition as a CHED Internationalization Champions of Nation-Building and Sustainability (ICONS) Awardee—an important milestone that highlights the University’s growing global presence and commitment to internationalization. This distinction follows BISU’s inclusion in the World University Rankings for Innovation (WURI)

item.title: BISU Soars to the Top! A Triumph of Excellence in Teacher Education
item.description: BISU proudly raises the banner of academic excellence as it once again emerges as a Top Performing School in the Philippines with the latest results of the September–November 2025 Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers! A massive congratulations to our new Licensed Professional Teachers (LPTs)! Your success is the result of grit, hard work, and perseverance.

item.title: BISU Produces Topnotchers in the September–November 2025 Licensure Examination for Teachers
item.description: Congratulations to the outstanding BISU topnotchers who passed the recent September–November 2025 Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers (LET)! The entire university community is incredibly proud of you! May this success mark the beginning of your meaningful journey in shaping young minds of future Filipino leaders.

item.title: BISU Receives DOST-NCRP Engagement Achievement Award
item.description: For two consecutive years, Bohol Island State University (BISU) has been recognized by the Department of Science and Technology–National Research Council of the Philippines (DOST–NRCP) for its exemplary performance in research and development, earning the Engagement Achievement Award for 2025.

item.title: BISU Arki Grad Claims 8th Spot in 2026 PH Arch Exam
item.description: 𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐆𝐑𝐀𝐓𝐔𝐋𝐀𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍𝐒 to our newest BISU architecture graduate for ranking Top 8 in the January 2026 Philippine Licensure Examination for Architects! A graduate of Bohol Island State University (BISU) Main Campus, Arch. Agoot’s achievement in the exams held on January 20 and 22, 2026 reflects her dedication and the high standards of our institution.

item.title: BISU Produces New Architects, Achieves 95.92% Passing Rate in January 2026 LEA
item.description: 𝐖𝐄 𝐀𝐑𝐄 𝐁𝐄𝐀𝐌𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐖𝐈𝐓𝐇 𝐏𝐑𝐈𝐃𝐄 as we announce the success of our architecture graduates from Bohol Island State University! BISU continues to demonstrate academic excellence with a stellar 95.92% overall passing rate gained from the January 2026 Philippine Licensure Examination for Architects (LEA), including a flawless 100% passing rate for our first-time takers.

item.title: A Historic Victory: BISU Crowned First-Ever ASUGBOHOL Culture and Arts Festival Overall Champion
item.description: History has been written at the UP Cebu grounds. In the landmark inaugural year of the festival, violet bleeds victorious as Bohol Island State University (BISU) is officially announced as the 𝐅𝐈𝐑𝐒𝐓-𝐄𝐕𝐄𝐑 𝐎𝐕𝐄𝐑𝐀𝐋𝐋 𝐂𝐇𝐀𝐌𝐏𝐈𝐎𝐍 of ASUGBOHOL: Regional Culture & Arts Festival (RCAF)!
